summary: Verdict: UNVERIFIABLE (25% confidence). Decisive facts: Satya Nadella was Chairman and CEO of Microsoft as of May 2025 (per sources dated 2025-07-23 and 2026-09-22); Microsoft Build 2025 occurred May 19-22, 2025 (per multiple sources). No credible evidence was located showing a coffee meeting with the board on the morning before Build 2025 (May 18, 2025).
